title: Drift-aware tour audit — vitals Check #8 with build-time anchor drift detection
rationale: Strategic relevance: DIFFERENTIATE. Plan source: docs/followups.md item #4 (locked via /vibe-iterate:competitive PR #2 atlas runners-up + /vibe-iterate:rate). The unique-moat ship: vendors structurally cannot match this because they have no emitted tour module to diff against (Chameleon Ranger fixes drift at runtime; we prevent at build time). :rate total 21/25. Cart-detection: light flow. Posture: read-only (never auto-fix); defense-in-depth via negative-lookbehind regex AND explicit tour-dir skip (either alone catches the steps file's own selectors, both makes it robust); 'renamed' intentionally NOT detected in v1 (heuristic risk — missing/orphan pair already surfaces the info honestly); graceful no-tour and no-source statuses distinct from drift; plugin-repo invocation marks Check #8 as ✓ N/A. Wired as Check #8 in vitals SKILL with build-plan.json detection, summary counts updated 7→8. Two scanner bugs surfaced + fixed via test-first discipline (regex matching selectors; scanner counting steps file as source). 15 new tests across 8 classes.

Three-feature plan-doc shipped end-to-end across 5 PRs (4 feature, 3 strikethrough): walk-advisory, permalink, tour-i18n, drift-audit, jest-30.
